title: Downloads that match the page
items: Every download (the PDF, Word, your own form and the Link) now shows exactly what the Record page shows.
When you pick a choice, its sentence sits in the same box as your notes, and you can edit both.
COSHH data sheets keep their capitals and show one statement per line. Each exposure limit sits beside its own substance, and there is a Disposal code line.
When you pick the same choice again and again, Quickler learns it as a usual answer.
How long something lasts now has a "More than 2 hours" option.
Voice notes can be up to 30 minutes long.
Each Record shows how long the walk took, plus a total time.

title: Easier edits and tidier PDFs
items: If you delete a Record by mistake, you now get an Undo note and can bring it back.
Download all your data and get a link by email, so you do not have to wait on the page.
Contacts are easier to manage: Edit and History sit in one bar, and Delete and Save are in the pop-up.
The Records page has a search box for titles once you have more than ten Records.
PDFs draw groups of answers in neat boxes, and you can show several Usual answer pictures on a question.
A Fault is never saved cut off with dots, and the walk's own location is not swapped for an old Usual answer.
imageAlt: The Records page for a Check, with a Search titles box above the list of Records.

title: Photos in Word, tidier Record page
items: The Word file draws photos four to a row, no taller than 3.5 cm, the size they are in your own reports.
The To check box and its links are gone from the Record page.
imageAlt: A Record page with its answers, without a To check box.

title: Re-reading a Check keeps your questions
items: If a Check already has questions, re-reading it from What does this check cover? keeps every question and only adds new ones.
Only you delete questions, on the questions page.
imageAlt: The What does this check cover? screen of a Check, with a box to describe it or add files.

title: Usual answers and clearer Records
items: A question can have a Usual answer. It fills in the Record and prints after the answer.
A photo you caption now goes on the question your words describe.
The Record page, the Word file and the Link say each sentence once.
Every word beside an answer on the Record can be edited.
WhatsApp messages are shorter and end with just how to finish.
Questions with blank sub-questions are now counted properly in the score.
imageAlt: A Record page, with a pencil beside every answer so each can be edited.

title: Safer restarts and more photos
items: A paying firm's Record now holds up to 250 photos.
A photo, even one captioned with words like "start again", never restarts a walk that already has answers.
If a walk has answers, saying something that sounds like a restart asks you to reply restart first.
A bare Yes to the closing message no longer ticks every other question as OK.
A Formal report in your own template no longer has a View this report online line.
On a phone or touch screen, a shared Record has no section list in the way.

title: Better photos and Word reports
items: Times in reports are shown in UK time, for example 9.08 a.m.
Each photo on a Fault is sorted as a Fault photo or an OK photo.
When you give a Fault a rating, it is kept as you said it.
Your own template's words are kept as they are in the Formal report editor.
The To do list uses only what the person said on the job.
The More button looks the same on every page.
imageAlt: A Record page with the More button in the top bar and the time of the Record shown in UK time.

title: Edit in the row, landscape PDFs
items: Click the words on a Record to edit them in the row, with no pop-up.
Drag photos in and out of a question. You can delete a photo and bring it back.
A deleted photo is left off the PDF and the shared page.
PDFs are now landscape, a fifth smaller, with photos as small tiles and no cover page.
The billing page shows the real due date and every invoice you have paid.
Each question can be in the score or left out, and you can choose how silence counts.
imageAlt: A Record page with Captured answers, a pencil on each row to edit in place, and a panel to drag photos in and out.

title: Two small fixes
items: A question label keeps its last word. Only the OK? and Issue? tags are tidied away.
Downloading the PDF of a Record with a great many photos now redraws it, instead of giving you an old copy.

title: Your Check can have its own logo
items: A Check can have its own logo at the top of its PDF and shared pages.
You can write answers as points or as a paragraph, and make words bold.
Each To do line can be reworded.
Photos are turned upright and placed on the question they show.
A pencil on the location card lets you set where the work was.
After you say Done, Quickler listens to every voice note again and tells the speakers apart.
imageAlt: A Record page with a pencil on the Location card and a pencil beside each answer.

title: Long voice notes and a simpler list
items: A voice note can be ten minutes long. Quickler says it is working on it while it listens.
Saying done now gets a reply to say your Record is filed.
Every Record gets a title.
The Records page is one list with the newest first.
A failed photo now says so, and does not just vanish.
imageAlt: The Records page for a Check, as one list with the newest first.

title: A tidier Records page
items: The workbook download is now an Excel file with one row per Fault, and it says which walk each came from.
Shareable links say View-only.
The shared report fits a narrow phone screen.
A place with several things wrong with it is shown once.
A building's history is one click away.
Downloads now have proper names.
imageAlt: The Records page for a Check, with its downloads and share options.

title: People in one place
items: All your people are now in one list, with their role shown on each row.
Voice notes are kept so you can listen to them again next to the transcript.
The shared page says Completed by.
Pop-ups no longer have a Cancel button, because the cross already closes them.
A Record is checked once more before it is filed, so Faults match the answers.
imageAlt: The dashboard with All workflows on the left and one People list on the right.

title: Small wording fixes
items: The opener now tells you to say restart if you want to begin a Check again.
Messages use plainer words.
A schedule with no valid time no longer fires by mistake.
Sign-in links no longer fail when they expire.
A payment notice from the bank is never counted twice.
Safer handling of names and labels you type in.

title: Cleaner voice notes and a firmer opening message
items: The opening message is built the same way every time and lists every section of the Check, using its own wording.
Voice notes are cleaned of background noise before they are typed up, so windy sites come out better.
Saying Done is read strictly: only a clear finish files the Record, and anything not mentioned is marked as assumed OK on the message.
A good observation, such as a repair that went well, is no longer treated as a Fault, and it shows as a good note on the Record.
A section with no Faults under it no longer says it has an issue.
Records show a note on a flagged section's own heading, and only one note per sentence.
On the Records pages, a flagged question you can open in the issues list now scrolls straight to it.

title: Done files the Record, nothing else does
items: Saying all clear fills in the answers but never files the Record. You reply Done to file it.
A Record with a Fault on it is no longer thrown away when a message looks like a switch to another Check.
Switching Check and then declining keeps your last message.
Free plan photo limits now hold in the editor too, and the gallery says when you reach the limit.
A section is only marked OK when there is a clear answer; free text cannot turn a Not applicable into OK.
Turning a Check off stops its schedule and cancels its reminders.
The activity log shows UK time.
Powered by Quickler on a shared report links to the demo.

title: Logos on PDFs, and notes appear once
items: A firm's logo shows at the top of PDFs in place of its name, and on every page of the app.
A note now appears once, on the question it fits best, as plain text rather than in a grey box.
Only Yes or No questions can be a Fault: an identifier is never red.
Collapsed sections keep a small strip of their photos, and the photo gallery no longer shows captions.
Records show UK time, and Download in the activity history becomes a one-tap Share that copies the link.
Reading a long document into questions shows an honest progress bar, copes with big documents, and a second click cannot start it twice.
The first screen of a new Check goes straight to What does this check cover?
A Check that was never checked reads Not checked, not OK, and a question marked Not applicable is not a Fault.
Over the free limit is one clear message that names the date the quota resets.
A number that has been retired gets one reply pointing to the main number.

title: Done and Go behave
items: Saying Done files the Check you are in, and never asks you to confirm a switch.
A bare Go starts the Check with all its questions at once, rather than one question at a time.
A returning user who asks for a Check by name starts a new one rather than hearing it is already filed.
A bare number is taken as the answer to the question just asked, such as mileage.
An answer for one section no longer clears every other section, and a later Fault is not lost.
A bare OK after the demo asks for the trade again rather than stopping.

title: One Record view and sharing
items: The Records and the Check results pages are now one page, with a Share menu on every row to copy a link or download a PDF or spreadsheet.
A shared link shows the live Record, with a change log at the bottom.
Every field type can be edited on a Record, answer and note.
Photos open in a gallery with next and previous; clean sections show green and a flagged Check has a Mark as done button.
A question can sit inside another, two levels deep, and a Check's period can be Today or a rolling window.
Saving the questions page re-reads the Check every time.
A reminder now invites any reply, not just Go.
Deleting a Record really forgets it.
A powered-by Quickler line on a shared report takes you to quickler.co.
A free demo: a new number gets a ready-made welcome and a demo for its sector.
imageAlt: The one Records page for a Check, with a Share menu on each row.

title: Done files the Check
items: A clear Done files the Check, whatever state it is in.
A photo sent right after saying all good is kept and not scolded.
Done is no longer undone by an unanswered Fault.
A report review page shows the Quickler brand.

title: Honest times and a branded review page
items: Reports show the real time a Record was finished, in UK time, and who last edited it.
A Record is never described as filed when it was refused, and photos are accepted the moment they arrive.
The report review page shows the Quickler brand.
A new pricing page and a tidier menu, with Support merged into one page.

title: Share links, switching Checks and Guides
items: Share a Record with a Copy link button, a banner showing when the link expires, and downloads named after the firm, date and place.
Site reports have a top bar with the score, a signature block, and a Maps link and weather for the location.
You can switch to a different Check part way through a chat, and amend a Check you already filed.
Messages sent in quick succession are read as one, and none are lost if the AI is briefly down.
Each Check can switch Manager alerts and General notes on or off.
quickler.co has a Guides section with many new pages.

title: Site safety reports, location and weather
items: A new kind of report for site safety, which uses your photos and a sample of your own style to write the draft.
Questions can ask for the location and the weather.
A mileage that looks wrong is queried before the Record is finished.
Each Record has a photo gallery that shows the answer and your note beside every picture.
A Fault can be marked as reviewed once it has been dealt with.
Adding several people at once no longer lets the same phone number in twice.

title: Light and dark mode, Fault rules and history
items: The dashboard has a proper light mode and dark mode.
A Yes or No question has a control to flag it when the answer is Yes or No.
The Records page has a period picker, including All time.
A Check can follow on from another Check, and can ask about the previous Fault.
Date questions are checked as day, month, year and printed neatly in the PDF.
Friendly error pages appear if the site is being updated.
imageAlt: The dashboard in its light mode, showing Checks and people.

title: Sign in codes, exports and a recycle bin
items: Sign in with a link, or with a 6 digit code if your email blocks the link.
A billing page lets you cancel your plan, and voucher codes are checked before you upgrade.
Deleted firms, Checks and people sit in a 30 day recycle bin.
Download the data for one person or one Check, from a downloads page.
PDFs include the photos taken, and Fault notes show next to the answers.
Voice notes are understood in Checks, and a Help centre was added.
imageAlt: The dashboard with its Checks and the people list.

title: The first app
items: Sign in, set up your firm, build your first Check and pay by card.
Add managers and people, pause or delete them, and set a schedule for each Check.
Sign up guesses your firm name and website from your email, and picks up your colours and logo.
Download all your data as a ZIP.
A pricing page and customer terms on quickler.co, and a Sign in button for customers.
Voice notes are turned into text, and photos can be sent at any time.
imageAlt: The first Quickler app dashboard, with a firm, its Checks and its people.

title: Try it on WhatsApp
items: A Try it here page and button let you test Quickler on WhatsApp, with a short and a full demo.
Every demo step takes voice notes, and the report comes back as a branded PDF by email and WhatsApp.
The first Quickler weekly van check report.
A walkthrough video sits at the top of the homepage.
The site is refocused on reports and your own workflows.

title: quickler.co goes live
items: A new quickler.co with the Quickler logo, icon and look, and a homepage that points you to what you need.
Report pages show real report screenshots, with a form to describe your own problem.
Privacy and cookie pages, with a cookie choice.
Send notes and photos on WhatsApp and get a PDF report back, with a cover page.
Review the report on a web page before it is sent.
